run_bites.headline: Best hours helped, weak formats didn’t
run_bites.explainer: Timing is not the problem here. She posted 6 of 10 in her best window, but some of those still sank because the format itself was soft — "one quick min before i serve" landed top 75% at 16:00, and "the boy was clearly the problem" hit top 68% at the same hour. So yes, keep the 3 to 4 pm habit, but you do not need to force more direct-to-camera riffs and pose montages just because the clock is right.
